title: vitis duarteana
intro: Vitis duarteana, commonly known as the wild grape vine, is a plant species native to Mexico. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Vitis duarteana include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its potential therapeutic effects.
